title: Rabbi Avin Ish Nachum
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Yalkut Bo, section 191, mentions Rabbi Berechyah reporting Rabbi Avin Ish Nachum: “Let them take for themselves a man”—this is the Holy One, blessed be He. Hyman gives the reading in Pesikta deRav Kahana, at the historical folio locator 55b, as Rabbi Berechyah reporting Rabbi Abbahu, followed by Nachum expounding in Rabbi Simai’s name. Hyman proposes the reading in Pesikta Rabbati, HaChodesh 24: “Nachum, son of Rabbi Simai, expounded.”

notes.text: Hyman’s proposed correction makes Nachum the son of Rabbi Simai, rather than a speaker in Simai’s name. The readings differ both in names and in father-versus-reporting relationships.

The consulted Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 191 contains the Avin/Ish Nachum wording. The exact Pesikta deRav Kahana folio 55b and Pesikta Rabbati HaChodesh 24 editions were not independently inspected here; their readings and Hyman’s preferred father-versus-reporting construction remain attributed to him.
